fusions.name: Garrote Haymaker
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A blow with a looped line that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Troop's Bolas
fusions.desc: After a 0.4 second cast, hurls 3 weighted cords at once, spread apart. Each cord deals 16 damage, plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves its target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Swing Hand Over Hand
fusions.desc: Swings you 4 tiles forward on a strand. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Wrap and Wrench
fusions.desc: Every hit you land winds a loop round that enemy, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per loop. Unfed, a loop fades every 4 seconds.
